players.name: Brock Purdy
wk: Brock Richard Purdy is an American professional football quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Iowa State Cyclones and was selected by the 49ers with the final pick in the 2022 NFL draft, becoming that year's Mr. Irrelevant.

players.name: George Kittle
wk: George Krieger Kittle is an American professional football tight end for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Iowa Hawkeyes and was selected by the 49ers in the fifth round of the 2017 NFL draft. Kittle is a seven-time Pro Bowler and was a first-team All-Pro in 2019 and 2023.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
wk: Christian Jackson McCaffrey is an American professional football running back for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Stanford Cardinal and was selected by the Carolina Panthers eighth overall in the 2017 NFL draft. As a sophomore in 2015, McCaffrey was named AP College Football Player of the Year and was a finalist for the Heisman Trophy. He holds the NCAA record for most all-purpose yards in a season (3,864).

players.name: Keenan Allen
wk: Keenan Alexander Allen is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the California Golden Bears before leaving after his junior year. He was selected by the then San Diego Chargers in the third round of the 2013 NFL draft. Allen has also played for the Chicago Bears.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
wk: Tyshun Raequan "Deebo" Samuel Sr.  is an American professional football wide receiver and kick returner for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the South Carolina Gamecocks, earning first-team All-American honors in 2018. Samuel was selected by the 49ers in the second round of the 2019 NFL draft. With San Francisco, Samuel received Pro Bowl and first-team All-Pro honors in 2021 after leading the league in average receiving yards. He was traded in 2025 to the Washington Commanders before rejoining the 49ers the following year. Samuel holds the NFL record for rushing touchdowns by a wide receiver and is the only wide receiver in league history to have at least 20 receiving and 20 rushing touchdowns.

players.name: Jordan Watkins
wk: Tyrell Jordan Watkins is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Louisville Cardinals and Ole Miss Rebels. Watkins was selected by the 49ers in the fourth round of the 2025 NFL draft.

players.name: Mike Evans
wk: Michael Lynn Evans III is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies, earning consensus All-American honors in 2013 and setting the school's record for receiving yards. Evans was selected seventh overall by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in the 2014 NFL draft.

players.name: Kyle Juszczyk
wk: Kyle Patrick Juszczyk is an American professional football fullback for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Harvard Crimson and was selected by the Baltimore Ravens in the fourth round of the 2013 NFL draft.

players.name: Luke Farrell
wk: Luke Farrell is an American professional football tight end for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ohio State Buckeyes and was drafted by the Jacksonville Jaguars in the fifth round of the 2021 NFL draft.

players.name: Demarcus Robinson
wk: Demarcus Dontavian Robinson is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Florida Gators and was selected by the Kansas City Chiefs in the fourth round of the 2016 NFL draft. Robinson won Super Bowl LIV with the Chiefs and has also been a member of the Las Vegas Raiders, Baltimore Ravens, and Los Angeles Rams.

players.name: Brandin Cooks
wk: Brandin Tawan Cooks is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oregon State Beavers, receiving the Fred Biletnikoff Award and consensus All-American honors in 2013 after leading the NCAA in receiving yards. Cooks was selected by the New Orleans Saints in the first round of the 2014 NFL draft and has also played for the New England Patriots, Los Angeles Rams, Houston Texans, Dallas Cowboys, and Buffalo Bills.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
wk: De'Zhaun-Ryan Demetrios Stribling is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Ole Miss Rebels, Washington State Cougars, and Oklahoma State Cowboys. He was selected by the 49ers in the second round of the 2026 NFL draft.

players.name: Jacob Cowing
wk: Jacob Henry Cowing is an American professional football wide receiver and punt returner for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the UTEP Miners and Arizona Wildcats and was selected by the 49ers in the fourth round of the 2024 NFL draft.

players.name: Christian Kirk
wk: Christian Davon Kirk is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Texas A&M Aggies and was selected by the Arizona Cardinals in the second round of the 2018 NFL draft. Kirk has also played for the Jacksonville Jaguars and Houston Texans.

players.name: Kaelon Black
wk: Kaelon Black is an American professional football running back for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the James Madison Dukes and the Indiana Hoosiers, winning the 2026 National Championship with the latter. Black was selected by the 49ers in the third round of the 2026 NFL draft.

players.name: KhaDarel Hodge
players.col: Prairie View A&M; Hinds CC; Alcorn State
wk: KhaDarel Jamal Hodge is an American professional football wide receiver for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Prairie View A&M Panthers and signed with the Los Angeles Rams as an undrafted free agent in 2018. Hodge has also played for the Cleveland Browns, Detroit Lions, and Atlanta Falcons.

players.name: Jake Tonges
wk: Jacob Tonges is an American professional football tight end for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the California Golden Bears and signed with the Chicago Bears as an undrafted free agent in 2022.

players.name: Brayden Willis
wk: Brayden Willis is an American professional football tight end for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oklahoma Sooners and was selected by the 49ers in the seventh round of the 2023 NFL draft.

players.name: Mac Jones
wk: Michael McCorkle "Mac" Jones is an American professional football quarterback for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Alabama Crimson Tide, setting the NCAA season records for passer rating and completion percentage in 2020 en route to winning the 2021 College Football Playoff National Championship. Jones also received Johnny Unitas Golden Arm, Davey O'Brien, and Manning awards. He was selected by the New England Patriots in the first round of the 2021 NFL draft.

players.name: Jordan James
wk: Jordan James is an American professional football running back for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Oregon Ducks and was selected in fifth round of the 2025 NFL draft.

players.name: Jack Stoll
wk: Jack Stoll is an American professional football tight end for the San Francisco 49ers of the National Football League (NFL). Stoll played college football for the Nebraska Cornhuskers and was signed by the Eagles as an undrafted free agent following the 2021 NFL draft.
